attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 14 streaming replication across node1 (originally primary), node2, and node3 (standbys). Simulated primary loss by stopping PostgreSQL on node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, and rejoined node1 as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup. Verified writes on node2 replicate to both standbys. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node3, then node2 (the current primary) one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, confirming boot_id changes and full replication/data recovery after each, preserving quorum throughout.
